result.title: Towards a Data-Centric Understanding of Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
result.comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, Under review at Artificial Intelligence Review
result.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been widely applied in embodied agents and robotics for vision tasks. However, MLLMs suffer from limitations in spatial reasoning and perception. Post-training techniques have shown promise for improving these capabilities; yet, there are limited data-driven surveys of such approaches. In this survey, we consider approaches to fine-tuning pretrained MLLMs for spatial reasoning tasks, ranging from supervised to reinforcement learning, with an emphasis on the datasets used. We investigate themes of dataset construction, data modality and annotation, and evaluation of the resulting models. Based on these themes, we categorize research into three groups: dataset design, dataset construction and evaluation. We find four main methods for constructing fixed spatial annotations: rules and templates, LLM prompting, procedural generation, and human-in-the-loop. We also observe substantial variation in evaluation approaches, including different scoring methods, tolerance metrics, and benchmark types. Finally, we identify opportunities for future research in unified dynamic annotation, efficient spatial reasoning, standardization of evaluation, expanded spatial range, and human-centered spatial interactions.

AI.brief_summary: 一篇综述，从数据视角梳理为空间推理任务微调预训练 MLLM 的监督到强化学习工作，按数据集设计、构建与评测三类组织，归纳规则模板、LLM 提示、程序化生成、人在回路四类标注构建方法，并指出动态标注、高效空间推理、评测标准化等方向。
AI.relevance_reason: 空间推理依赖几何与实体关系是否保留在内部状态中，属主线关注的能力；其数据集构建方式与评测差异（评分、容差、基准类型）可供核查 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与评测设计，但原文未直接考察 latent 状态或推理过程。
